RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the March 5, 2008/Phalguna 15, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Earth Sciences; Home Affairs;
 Information and Broadcasting; Labour  and Employment; Parliamentary
Affairs; Rural Development; Science and Technology; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
31
CAG   report    regarding
misappropriation of funds
 under  NREGS
*101. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Comptroller and
Auditor General in his report has found
cases where the funds earmarked to
National Rural Employment Guarantee
Scheme (NREGS) have been
misappropriated;
(b) if so, whether any steps have been
taken to check the occurrences of
misappropriation of funds allocated to the
NREGS;
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
the  level of compliance by the implementing
bodies; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Non-availability of central forces for
the naxal affected States
*102. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Centre has reportedly told
the naxal affected States that they should
not ask for more Central Reserve Police
Force to handle naxalism in their States;
(b) whether the Centre has also asked
States that they  should focus on filling up
the vacant posts in their police set up;
(c) whether this matter was debated at
the two-day meeting of the task force,
constituted by the Union Home Ministry
on the naxalite problem in the country;
(d) if so, the reactions of the States to
these proposals; and
(e) the steps being taken by the States
in this regard?
 Terrorist camps near Hubli
*103. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that terrorist
camps have been unearthed in the forests
near Hubli and the Karnataka Police has
arrested three terrorists;
(b) whether Government has identified
terrorist organization supporting this
terrorist group; and

32
(c) the plan of action of Government to
control the spread of terrorist organizations
throughout the country?
 Special law to curb boot-legging and
property grabbing
*104. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state whether Government is
considering to promulgate a special law to
curb the unlawful activities  of boot-leggers
and property grabbers?
 Gap between requirement of officers and
their recruitment in armed forces
*105. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a large gap has arisen
between the requirement of officers in the
three wings of our Defence Forces and the
numbers recruited over the last several
years;
(b) if so, the reasons for the same;
(c) the steps being contemplated, if any,
by Government to address the issue;
(d) whether it is a fact that recruitment
of jawans in the Defence Forces has been
unsatisfactory in terms of number of
enthusiasts opting for the career, especially
in the regions which have been traditionally
attracting young generations to the forces;
(e) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(f) the steps contemplated to improve
it?
 Modernization of NTC mills
*106. SHRI RA VULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: W ill the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has spent about Rs. 530 crore for
modernization of NTC mills and the
production facilities have been upgraded;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years especially in Andhra
Pradesh; and
(c) the future programme of NTC in the
country?
 Upgradation of ITIs as Centres of
Excellence
*107. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) what are the elements of the Centres
of Excellence for the ITIs;
(b) on what basis are they selected under
this scheme;
(c) of these, in how many, the Institute
Management Committees (IMCs) with
private participation are in place and how
are the Members of the IMC selected; and
(d) how many of the 100 ITIs taken up
for upgradation during 2006-07, have
availed the aid from World Bank and what
is the pattern of financing this project?
 Distribution of Indian movies
through pirated VCD/DVD
*108. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that VCD/DVD
producers are duping Government of large
sums  by distributing Indian movies through
piracy without paying prescribed Rs. 10/-
per VCD/DVD;

33
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to ensure
lawful distribution of Indian films through
VCD/DVD?
 Depriving women officers from
permanent commission
*109. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
about 1000, 570 and 160 women in Army,
Air Force and Navy respectively;
(b) if so, what are the reasons that
women officers do not get permanent
commission;
(c) whether it is also a fact that though
since 1990s women officers are being
inducted into the Armed Forces, they are
being deprived from permanent
commission; and
(d) if so, the reaction of Government on
the above?
 Revamping of EPF networking and
digitalisation project
*110. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the project, launched almost
seven years ago to provide access to
members of Employees' Provident Fund
(EPF) through networking and digitalisation
of more than 110 EPF offices, is to be
revamped;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether the EPFO Board of Trustees
has taken a decision to re-launch this much
delayed project and if so, the details thereof?
 Threat of naxalism to internal
security
 *111. DR. (SHRIMATI) NAJMA A.
HEPTULLA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
naxalism is the biggest threat to internal
security;
(b) whether it is a fact that the forested
regions of Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand,
Telangana and Vidarbha are the main centres
of relatively successful Maoist activity;
(c) whether the absence of sufficient
public intervention specially in Education,
Health and Employment has allowed non-
State  factors to push their agenda among
the tribals; and
(d) if so, the details of the schemes
launched in tribal and naxal infested areas
and their impact?
 Global marketing of DRDO
products
*112. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has received
any orders from some countries for Defence
Research and Development Organisation
(DRDO) products; if so, the details thereof;
and
(b)  if not, the steps being taken to
market these products globally?

34
 Nexus of terrorist organisations at
international level
†*113. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the terrorist
organisations have nexus at international
level to make their plan in order to create
terror in the country;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) the names of the organisations which
have been identified for creating violence in
the country through international nexus,
till now; and
(d) the names of overseas Governments
alongwith details of concrete action taken
by our Government with them in order to
stop activities of these organisations?
 Telephone tapping
*114. DR. V . MAITREYAN: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that selective
category of persons are being subjected to
telephone tapping across the country;
(b) if so, even the politicians who are
mainly senior functionaries of the
opposition party are being subjected to
telephone tapping;
(c) if so, the reasons for this type of
phone tapping exercises undertaken across
the country; and
(d) the basis on which the people are
selected for this type of telephone tapping?
 Hike in cement prices
*115. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the supply of cement in the
country has been affected and its prices
have gone up recently;
(b) if so, the increase in the  prices of
cement registered during the last one year,
month-wise, and the impact thereof on the
construction industry;
(c) whether the Builders Association of
India has protested by announcing
stoppage of construction activity in the
country against unfair business practices
of cement manufacturers; and
(d) if so, the action taken/proposed to
be taken by Government against cement
manufacturers  and the steps taken by
Government to bring down the prices of
cement?
 Naxal violence in Orissa
†*116. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Orissa has been a victim of
terrible naxal violence in the recent past;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the details of assistance sought by
the State from the Centre to deal with this
problem;
(d) the kind of assistance provided by
the Centre so far; and
(e) the year-wise details of loss of life
and property due to naxal violence during
the last five years?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

35
 States covered under SEZ
*117. DR. K. MALAISAMY: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the States and the cases already
covered under Special Economic Zone;
(b) which are the States that are not in
agreement with the objectives and
provisions of the Special Economic Zones
Act;
(c) in such cases, what is the approach
of Government thereto; and
(d) will there be a consistent view in
conformity with the Act or a flexible view
as a measure of time saving?
 Product profile of ordnance factories
*118. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of ordnance factories
under the Department of Defence
Production;
(b) the product profile of the factories;
and
(c) the product-wise order book
position and capacity utilization of
ordnance factories during the last three
years?
 New Defence  Purchase  Policy
*119. SHRIMA TI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is thinking of having a new Defence
Purchase Policy so as to quicken the
process of Defence purchases for the safety
and security of the country;
(b) if so, the salient features of the
proposed new policy; and
(c) whether the new policy mandates
that all foreign players who have won the
defence supplies, have to transfer the
technology, which otherwise is not present
now?
 Special law to curb crime by organized
gangs and syndicates
*120. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
promulgation of any special law to curb
criminal activities by organized criminal
gangs  and syndicates; and
(b) if not, how does Government plan
to handle these activities?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 28th February, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 9, 1929 (Saka)

I N D E X
